verdict.rationale: Deel documents a REST API (e.g., POST /rest/contracts to create contractor contracts) and an MCP server whose tools map to API operations across contracts, people, payroll, time off, and cost calculations, supported by OAuth2/API tokens, webhooks, versioning, and a sandbox. Nothing in the evidence states or shows that the API matches the UI feature-for-feature, so the evidenced surface covers only a subset of what the platform markets (hiring, payroll in 150+ countries, equipment). Missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity statement or full endpoint coverage map, evidence for payroll-run execution, equipment, and onboarding via API, and independent hands-on corroboration of breadth.
